# API endpoints - contract
# [backend] Append a row when you add an endpoint; regenerate a row when you change one.
#           Keep this in sync with the route + the Bruno request as ONE atomic change.
# [frontend] Read-only copy brought from the backend repo. Do not edit here.

| Method | Path | Auth | Request | Response | Notes |
|--------|------|------|---------|----------|-------|
| GET | /api/health | none | - | `{ data: [{ online: true, db: "up" | "down", haCache: "ready" | "warming" | "off" }] }` | Liveness of the API. `db` = last known PostgreSQL state (pool ping every 30s, pool error event). `haCache` = HA WebSocket cache state (ready = served from memory; warming/off = REST fallback). Always 200, also when `db` is `down`, so the Docker healthcheck never restart-loops on a db blip. |
| GET | /api/ha/status | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [{ online: true, message, version }] }` | Checks HA link (`GET /api/` + `GET /api/config`). Errors: `ha_not_configured` 503, `ha_unreachable` 503, `ha_unauthorized` 502, `ha_unexpected_response` 502. |
| GET | /api/entities?domain=&area= | Bearer API_TOKEN | query: `domain` (HA domain), `area` (area id) both optional | `{ data: [{ entityId, domain, name, state, attributes, area, areaName, deviceName, lastChanged }] }` sorted by name | `area` = HA area id or null; `attributes` = safe subset; covers also carry `estimated_position` (0..100 or null). `deviceName` = HA device name (`name_by_user` or `name`) or null (no device / unknown); via HA `/api/template`, cached 60s, failure -> null. Unknown filter -> `[]`. Area via HA `/api/template`, cached 30s. |
| POST | /api/entities/:entityId/action | Bearer API_TOKEN | `{ "action": string, "params"?: { brightness, brightness_pct, color_temp, temperature, position, percentage, hvac_mode, preset_mode, volume_level } }`. Actions per domain: light/switch/fan/scene/script/media_player: `turn_on`, `turn_off`, `toggle`; cover: `open_cover`, `close_cover`, `stop_cover`, `set_cover_position` (`position`), `toggle`; climate: `turn_on`, `turn_off`, `set_temperature` (`temperature`), `set_hvac_mode` (`hvac_mode`), `set_preset_mode` (`preset_mode`); lock: `lock`, `unlock` | `{ data: [normalized entity] }` (new state; includes `deviceName`) | Domains allowlist: light, switch, climate, cover, fan, media_player, scene, script, lock. Every call that reaches the entity (after id validation) is recorded in the event log as `action` (018), also on failure (`ok: false`, `error`); invalid entity ids are not recorded. For a calibrated cover, a running timed move is cancelled: `stop_cover` keeps the elapsed estimate; `open_cover`/`close_cover` start a full-leg timer (position `null` until it ends at 100/0); other cover actions make the position `null`. Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400, `invalid_action` 400 (action not valid for the entity's domain), `invalid_params` 400, `domain_not_allowed` 403, `entity_not_found` 404. |
| GET | /api/areas | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [{ areaId, name, entities: [normalized entity] }] }` (covers include `attributes.estimated_position`) (every normalized entity includes `deviceName`, resolved with the cached 60s device index) | Areas from HA (empty ones included) sorted by name, plus a final `{ areaId: null, name: "Unassigned" }` group. Each entity appears exactly once; entities sorted by name. Reuses HA `/api/template` (cached 30s) and `/api/states`. |
| GET | /api/stream?domain=&once=&clientId= | Bearer API_TOKEN, or `?token=API_TOKEN` (EventSource fallback; only this route) | query: `domain` (plain HA domain, `^[a-z_]+$`, optional), `once=1` (smoke mode: send `ready` and close), `clientId` (optional UUID, identity only; used when no `X-Client-Id` header) | SSE `text/event-stream`: `event: ready` `data: {domain}` first, then `event: ha_link` `data: { connected, at }` (019: current HA link, `at` null before the first transition; not sent in `once=1`), then `event: state_changed` `data: normalized entity` per HA change; `: ping` every 25s; `event: resource_changed` `data: { resource, keys, by }` for every app change (resource `aliases` | `calibrations` | `alert_rules` | `settings`; `by` = writer client id or null; `keys` = changed keys, `[]` (refetch all) when more than 100). `resource_changed` ignores `domain`. `event` `data: <stored event row>` for every event-log row written (018, same shape as `GET /api/events`); ignores `domain`. `event: alert` `data: <alert>` when an alert fires (020, same shape as `GET /api/alerts`); `event: alert_acked` `data: { id, ackedAt, ackedBy }` on the first ack of an alert (020); both ignore `domain`. | `state_changed` data carries the normalized entity incl. `deviceName` and, for covers, `attributes.estimated_position`. `event: ha_link` `data: { connected, at }` on every real HA link transition (019). One shared HA WebSocket for all clients, kept open for the life of the API from boot (019), reconnecting forever with backoff. Reconnects with backoff 1s..30s. Errors before the stream opens: `invalid_domain` 400, `missing_credentials` 401, `not_authorized` 403. Never log the query string. |
| GET | /api/history?entityIds=&hours= | Bearer API_TOKEN | query: `entityIds` (comma-separated, required, max 20 distinct, entity id regex), `hours` (int 1..720, default 24) | `{ data: [{ entityId, points: [{ t: ISO, v: string }] }] }` one item per requested entity, request order; `points: []` when HA has no history | Source: HA `/api/history/period` with `minimal_response` and `significant_changes_only`, window = last `hours` up to now. Errors: `missing_entity_ids` 400, `invalid_entity_id` 400, `too_many_entities` 400, `invalid_hours` 400. |
| GET | /api/aliases | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [{ entityId, alias }] }` sorted by `entityId`; `data: []` when empty | User-editable friendly names, served from memory (loaded from `ALIASES_FILE` at startup). Entities/areas/stream never carry `alias`; the client merges. |
| PUT | /api/aliases/:entityId | Bearer API_TOKEN | body `{ "alias": string }` | `{ data: [{ entityId, alias }] }` (stored, normalized value) | Creates or replaces. `alias` normalized: trim + collapse whitespace runs to one space; 1..80 chars, no control chars. No HA call (works while HA is down). Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400 (regex `^[a-z_]+\.[a-z0-9_]+$`), `invalid_alias` 400 (missing, non-string, empty, >80, control chars), `too_many_aliases` 400 (would create alias #2001; replacing is always allowed), `aliases_write_failed` 500 (memory unchanged). |
| DELETE | /api/aliases/:entityId | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [] }` | Idempotent: 200 also when no alias existed. Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400, `aliases_write_failed` 500. |
| GET | /api/calibrations | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [{ entityId, openMs, closeMs, position, calibratedAt }] }` sorted by `entityId`; `data: []` when empty | Cover travel-time calibrations (open/close duration in ms), served from memory (loaded from `CALIBRATIONS_FILE` at startup). `position` is `null` (unknown) until a percent calibration exists. No HA call. |
| PUT | /api/calibrations/:entityId | Bearer API_TOKEN | body `{ "openMs": int, "closeMs": int }` | `{ data: [{ entityId, openMs, closeMs, position, calibratedAt }] }` (stored entry; `position` reset to `null`) | Creates or replaces. Integers 500..300000. Only `cover` entities. No HA call (works while HA is down). Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400 (regex `^[a-z_]+\.[a-z0-9_]+$`), `domain_not_allowed` 403 (not a `cover`), `invalid_calibration` 400 (missing, non-integer, out of range), `too_many_calibrations` 400 (would create entry #201; replacing is always allowed), `calibrations_write_failed` 500 (memory unchanged). |
| DELETE | /api/calibrations/:entityId | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [] }` | Idempotent: 200 also when no calibration existed. Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400, `domain_not_allowed` 403, `calibrations_write_failed` 500. |
| POST | /api/entities/:entityId/cover-percent | Bearer API_TOKEN | body `{ "percent": int }` (0..100, 100 = fully open) | `{ data: [normalized entity] }` (`attributes.estimated_position` = live estimate) | Requires a calibration (010). Targets 0 and 100 drive the full leg (+10% margin, works with unknown position, no stop); intermediate targets need a known position and send `stop_cover` after the proportional time. A new request cancels a running move (stop_cover, estimate kept). Position is persisted at move end/cancel and set to `null` when a move starts. No HA call before validation and calibration. Recorded in the event log as `action` with `action: "cover_percent"`, `params: { percent }` (018), also on failure. Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400, `domain_not_allowed` 403 (not a `cover`), `invalid_params` 400 (percent not an integer 0..100), `not_calibrated` 409, `position_unknown` 409 (intermediate target, unknown position), `entity_not_found` 404. |
| GET | /api/alert-rules?entityId= | Bearer API_TOKEN | query: `entityId` (optional, `^[a-z_]+\.[a-z0-9_]+$`) | `{ data: [{ id, entityId, trigger, level, message? }] }` sorted by `entityId` then `id`; `data: []` when empty | Notification rules (012), served from memory (loaded from `ALERT_RULES_FILE` at startup). `trigger` is one of `{ type: "connects" }`, `{ type: "disconnects" }`, `{ type: "interacted" }`, `{ type: "state_becomes", value }` (string 1..40), `{ type: "above"\|"below", value }` (finite number). `level` = `off`\|`low`\|`medium`\|`high`. Orphan rules (entity gone from HA) are kept. No HA call. Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400. |
| POST | /api/alert-rules | Bearer API_TOKEN | body `{ entityId, trigger, level, message? }` (`message` string 1..120 when present; any `id` in the body is ignored) | `{ data: [{ id, entityId, trigger, level, message? }] }` (created; `id` server-generated UUID) | Creates a rule. Evaluation happens on the API (020, server-side engine on the HA hub); the rules are read from memory on every change. No HA call (works while HA is down). Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400, `invalid_rule` 400 (bad trigger, level, message or body), `too_many_rules` 400 (would create rule #501), `duplicate_rule` 409 (same entity and trigger type+value already has a rule), `alert_rules_write_failed` 500 (memory unchanged). |
| PUT | /api/alert-rules/:id | Bearer API_TOKEN | body `{ entityId, trigger, level, message? }` (same rules as POST) | `{ data: [{ id, entityId, trigger, level, message? }] }` (stored rule) | Replaces the rule with this id; `id` immutable. Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400, `invalid_rule` 400, `duplicate_rule` 409 (another rule has the same entity and trigger), `rule_not_found` 404, `alert_rules_write_failed` 500 (memory unchanged). |
| DELETE | /api/alert-rules/:id | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [] }` | Idempotent: 200 also when no rule existed. Errors: `alert_rules_write_failed` 500. |
| GET | /api/presets?entityId= | Bearer API_TOKEN | query: `entityId` (optional, `^[a-z_]+\.[a-z0-9_]+$`) | `{ data: [{ id, entityId, name, percent, createdAt }] }` sorted by `entityId`, `percent`, `name`; `data: []` when empty | Saved actuator positions (021), global for the household, served from memory (Postgres collection `presets`). v1 domain `cover` only. No HA call. Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400. |
| POST | /api/presets | Bearer API_TOKEN (`X-Client-Id` sets the change event `by`) | body `{ entityId, name, percent }` (`entityId` must be `cover.*`; `name` trimmed 1..30 chars, no control chars; `percent` integer 0..100) | `{ data: [{ id, entityId, name, percent, createdAt }] }` (created; `id` server-generated UUID) | Creates a preset. Max 10 per entity and 500 in total. Names are unique per entity, case-insensitive. Emits `resource_changed` `presets` (SSE). No HA call. Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400, `domain_not_allowed` 403 (not a cover), `invalid_preset` 400, `too_many_presets` 400, `duplicate_preset` 409, `presets_write_failed` 500 (memory unchanged). |
| PUT | /api/presets/:id | Bearer API_TOKEN | body `{ name, percent }` (same rules as POST; `entityId` optional but must equal the stored one) | `{ data: [{ id, entityId, name, percent, createdAt }] }` | Renames / re-percents one preset; `id` and `entityId` immutable. Errors: `invalid_preset` 400 (bad fields or a different `entityId`), `duplicate_preset` 409, `preset_not_found` 404, `presets_write_failed` 500. |
| DELETE | /api/presets/:id | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [] }` | Idempotent: 200 also when no preset existed. Errors: `presets_write_failed` 500. |
| POST | /api/presets/:id/apply | Bearer API_TOKEN (`X-Client-Id` sets the event initiator) | - | `{ data: [normalized entity] }` | Drives the cover to the preset percent. Calibrated cover (010): the 011 timed move, same errors as `POST /api/entities/:id/cover-percent` (`position_unknown` 409 for intermediate targets, a calibrated cover is never `not_calibrated` here). Otherwise a cover with a numeric `current_position`: HA `cover.set_cover_position` through the 011 cancel hook. Else `preset_not_applicable` 409. Records an `action` event (`action: "preset"`, `params { presetId, percent }`, `ok`, `error?`). Errors: `preset_not_found` 404, `entity_not_found` 404, `preset_not_applicable` 409, `position_unknown` 409. |
| GET | /api/alerts?status=&limit= | Bearer API_TOKEN | query: `status` (`open`|`all`, default `open`), `limit` (integer 1..200, default 50) | `{ data: [alert] }` newest first; `alert` = `{ id, ruleId, entityId, level, text, firedAt, ackedAt, ackedBy, clientId }` | Alerts fired by the server-side engine (020). `open` = not acked and fired within the last 24 h. `ruleId` null for test-fire alerts; `clientId` = initiator of an `interacted` firing, else null. No HA call. Errors: `invalid_query` 400 (bad status or limit). |
| POST | /api/alerts/:id/ack | Bearer API_TOKEN (`X-Client-Id` / `X-Client-Name` set `ackedBy`) | - | `{ data: [alert] }` with `ackedAt` and `ackedBy` | Acknowledges one alert. Idempotent: an already acked alert returns 200 unchanged (first ack kept, no event). Emits `alert_acked` (SSE) and logs an `alert_acked` event on the first ack only. Errors: `alert_not_found` 404 (unknown or malformed id). |
| POST | /api/alerts/ack-all | Bearer API_TOKEN (`X-Client-Id` sets `ackedBy`) | - | `{ data: [alert] }` (the alerts acked now; `[]` when none were open) | Acknowledges every open alert (not acked, fired within 24 h); one `alert_acked` SSE frame and event per alert. |
| POST | /api/alerts/test-fire | Bearer API_TOKEN | body `{ entityId, level, text }` (`entityId` `^[a-z_]+.[a-z0-9_]+# API endpoints - contract

, `level` `low`|`medium`|`high`, `text` 1..120) | `{ data: [alert] }` | Test hook, only when `NODE_ENV` is not `production` (in production the route does not exist: 404). Stores and emits an alert as if a rule fired. No HA call. Errors: `invalid_alert` 400. |
| GET | /api/settings | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [{ key, value, version, updatedAt, updatedBy }] }` sorted by `key`; `data: []` when empty | Shared app settings (017), global for the household, served from memory (Postgres collection `settings`). Server does not know the shape of `value` (the frontend validates it). No HA call. |
| GET | /api/settings/:key | Bearer API_TOKEN | path `key`: `^[a-z0-9]+(\.[a-z0-9_-]+){1,4}$`, max 80 chars | `{ data: [{ key, value, version, updatedAt, updatedBy }] }` | Errors: `invalid_setting_key` 400, `setting_not_found` 404. |
| PUT | /api/settings/:key | Bearer API_TOKEN | body `{ "value": any JSON (not undefined), "baseVersion"?: int >= 1 }` | `{ data: [{ key, value, version, updatedAt, updatedBy }] }` (stored) | New key -> version 1; changed value -> version + 1, `updatedAt` now, `updatedBy` = writer client id (`X-Client-Id`) or null. Same value (JSON equal) -> no write, no version bump. `baseVersion` present and different from the current version (or key missing) -> 409 `version_conflict` with `data: [current setting]` (`data: []` when the key is missing); no `baseVersion` = last write wins. Emits `resource_changed` (`settings`) only on a real write. No HA call. Errors: `invalid_setting_key` 400, `invalid_setting` 400 (no `value`, or `baseVersion` not int >= 1), `setting_too_large` 413 (serialized value > 65536 bytes), `too_many_settings` 400 (would create key #201), `version_conflict` 409, `settings_write_failed` 500 (memory unchanged). |
| DELETE | /api/settings/:key | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [] }` | Idempotent: 200 also when the key did not exist; emits `resource_changed` only when something was removed. Errors: `invalid_setting_key` 400, `settings_write_failed` 500. |
| GET | /api/events?types=&entityId=&from=&to=&before=&limit= | Bearer API_TOKEN | query, all optional: `types` (comma list, max 10, each `^[a-z_]+$`), `entityId` (`^[a-z_]+\.[a-z0-9_]+$`), `from` / `to` (ISO 8601 date or instant, `from <= to`), `before` (event id cursor, digits only: only ids below it), `limit` (int 1..500, default 100) | `{ data: [{ id, ts, type, source, entityId, level, clientId, clientName, payload }] }` newest first (`ORDER BY id DESC`); `id` is a bigint string; `data: []` when nothing matches | Persistent event log (018) in the `events` table. Types: `action` (source `api`: device actions and cover-percent, payload `{ action, params?, ok, error? }`) and `config_changed` (source `api`: any `resource_changed`, payload `{ resource, keys }`, `clientId` = writer; values are never copied). `ha_link` (019, source `ha`, payload `{ connected }`, one per real HA link transition, boot connection included). `availability` (019, source `ha`, `entityId` set, payload `{ available: false, from }` when an entity becomes `unavailable`, `{ available: true, to }` when it leaves; `resync: true` when found by the reconnect snapshot; at most one per entity per 10 s, extras dropped). Retention `EVENTS_RETENTION_DAYS` (1..3650, default 365), purged hourly. Payloads over 4 KB are stored as `{ truncated: true }`. Writes are fire-and-forget (no `POST`). Errors: `invalid_query` 400 (any bad parameter, message names it). |

## Client identity headers

Optional, never required, never an error. Mounted on `/api` before the routes. Values are stored in `res.locals` and forwarded as `by` to the change bus. They are never logged.

| Header | Rule | Used for |
|--------|------|----------|
| `X-Client-Id` | UUID-shaped, `^[0-9a-f-]{36}$` case-insensitive. Otherwise ignored (`null`). | Writer id in `resource_changed.by`. |
| `X-Client-Name` | Control chars stripped, trimmed, 1..40 chars. Otherwise ignored (`null`). | Stored in the request context only (no response field yet). |
| `?clientId=` (query, `GET /api/stream` only) | Same rule as `X-Client-Id`. The header wins when both are present. | EventSource cannot send headers. |

CORS: `cors` reflects the requested headers, so `Authorization, Content-Type, X-Client-Id, X-Client-Name` pass preflight from `CORS_ORIGINS` with no extra allowlist.
